pages.title: Another Point of View
pages.text: Linked devices provide remote control and observation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Bind the totem by striking, then hold it while watching its target; control costs durability. Bind Beholder with an Occult Gem and use that gem elsewhere in the same dimension.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Ritual-created Watchers alternate claws and possession. Their possible Occult Gem supports tool binding; tracking the possessed viewpoint helps anticipate approach.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Direct a creature with a Totem of Possession and view through a bound Beholder. Bind the totem by striking, then hold it while watching its target; control costs durability. Bind Beholder with an Occult Gem and use that gem elsewhere in the same dimension.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Direct a creature with a Totem of Possession and view through a bound Beholder. Bind the totem by striking, then hold it while watching its target; control costs durability. Bind Beholder with an Occult Gem and use that gem elsewhere in the same dimension.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use two different techniques: delayed dagger, Dreadbow volley or Burrowing Arrow. The dagger leaves a delayed spectral strike. Shadow-Silk Dreadbow rains a volley; Corrodent-teeth Burrowing Arrows mine a limited number of blocks. Teeth also brew Haste.
